admission.split_authorization: Lead clarification: use full unsplit upstream generated file, partition by pattern family; no mirror or benchmark split is imported.

ancestry: 56 spatial inference seed problems from Ki-Sun Nam (1995), The Semantics of Locative Prepositional Phrases in English, and Joost Zwarts and Yoad Winter (2000), Vector Space Semantics: A Model-theoretic Analysis of Locative Prepositions.
Expert-authored revisions and NP-placeholder patterns, toy grammar, 171-entity mini-world and selection restrictions; labels from expert annotations, not model predictions.

SpaceNLI.source_scope: All 32000 upstream rows; scan raw and mapped forms before selection.
